# <span id="aanchor377"></span> Origin & Destination Editor

FLOWCAL allows users to specify an Origin and a Destination on tickets. This information is typically passed from FLOWCAL to a downstream accounting system.

The Origin/Destination Editor allows users to enter label names for origins and destinations that can be used on tickets.

**Example:** If the user enters the label name "Houston", this name will show up in the drop-down box for Origin and/or Destination in the Ticket Editor, as well as on the printed ticket.

<div class="procedure">

To add a new origin or destination:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  In the **Liquids** group, select **Origin and Destination Editor**.

3.  Select a label name from the list and click New to create a new label name for an origin and/or destination and enter its information using the fields at the bottom of the screen.

    The Label Name field should be a Shipping Location relevant to the Customer.

4.  You can also click **Edit** to modify an existing label name using the fields at the bottom of the screen.

5.  Specify whether the label name may be used as an origin, a destination, or both.

6.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

## Origin/Destination by SPLC Code

FLOWCAL can be configured to require that Origins and Destinations be labeled and named by SPLC Code rather than just by text strings of the user's own choosing. In order for this requirement to become effective, the user must enable the Use SPLC Code for Origins and Destinations option under [FLOWCAL Configuration](../Application/FLOWCAL%20Configuration.md).

The Standard Point Location Code (SPLC) is designed to provide each point originating freight and each point receiving freight in North America with a unique code number so constructed as to identify the point with its geographic location, using two digits to identify State, County and City and three digits to identify Sub-Code. Available SPLC codes can be found on the web at <a href="http://www.nmfta.org/pages/splc.aspx" class="InlineLink" target="_blank">http://www.nmfta.org/pages/splc.aspx</a>.

**Example:** If you enter an SPLC Code of "142000017", this code will show up in the drop down box for Origin and/or Destination in the Ticket Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To add an SPLC code:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **Liquids** group, select **Origin and Destination Editor**.
3.  Click **New** to create a new SPLC Ccode for an origin and/or destination and enter its information using the fields at the bottom of the screen.
4.  You can also select an SPLC code from the list and click **Edit** to modify an existing SPLC Code using the fields at the bottom of the screen.
5.  Specify whether the SPLC code may be used as an origin, a destination, or both.
6.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>
